title: The Sprightly Padawan
description: Ahsoka Tano was personally selected by Yoda to be Anakin Skywalker's Padawan. The choice was logical enough: Anakin was a remarkable warrior, but often reckless and undisciplined. Having an equally unpredictable Padawan under his wing was intended to teach him the value of caution and prudence, even as Tano greatly benefitted from Skywalker's inherent brilliance as a freedom fighter.
